reason: The hand-DM grind is real and I'd love to get those hours back, but $147 is three or four times what other DM tools charge and there are zero published results, so I'd be paying a premium on a promise. Card up front and 'payments final' after day 4 makes it feel like a bet I don't need to make.
objection: No customer results at all, and it costs 3-4x the other tools. Why would I pay the most for the one nobody has proof for, with my own Instagram on the line?
would_change_my_mind: Real results from agency owners like me (replies and booked calls from actual accounts), or a price closer to $60-80, or a no-card trial long enough to see replies come in.
